articles.summary: DLH announced that three DLH-supported programs have been named 2026 FORUM Innovation Award winners, recognizing top information technology (“IT”) programs nominated and selected by their peers for pushing the technology envelope.
articles.title: DLH Automation and AI Solutions Centerstage at Industry Innovation Awards

articles.summary: DLH today announced that it has been awarded a multiple-award indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity (“MAC ID/IQ”) contract to provide a full range of logistics information technology services for U.S. Navy integrated platforms and DevSecOps pipelines.
articles.title: DLH Contract Award Opens New Growth Channels with U.S Navy
